The vision

Between the mountains.
Beside the water.

Where the foothills of the Tian Shan meet the turquoise waters of Charvak, a new chapter of Sea Breeze is taking shape.

Conceived as an all-season resort and residential destination, Sea Breeze Uzbekistan brings homes, hospitality and open waterfront spaces into one considered masterplan. Nature is at the heart of everyday life.

The landscape
comes first.

Charvak is central to the identity of this destination. The developer’s published commitments focus on protecting water, strengthening infrastructure and restoring the green landscape.

10,000+trees planned
across the resort

More than 1,000 trees planted, as reported in August 2026.

Protecting the water

The published project requirements prohibit wastewater discharge into Charvak and require connection to the Chirchiq treatment system. Water quality monitoring is part of the environmental approach.

Building with care

Plans include energy-efficient technology suited to the local climate, environmentally certified materials and coordinated construction waste management.

Growing together

Preserving green spaces, planting trees and developing accessible public areas are accompanied by commitments to local jobs, small businesses and community initiatives.

One vision.
New horizons.

Sea Breeze Uzbekistan is being developed by Agalarov Development, whose international portfolio includes more than 60 projects across the CIS, Europe and Asia.

The destination builds on the experience of Sea Breeze Azerbaijan, the resort city on the Caspian coast, while responding to the character of Charvak and the landscape of Uzbekistan.

Questions

A little more
clarity.

Answers to the questions that matter.
For the latest details, speak with the Sea Breeze team.

Where is Sea Breeze Uzbekistan?

The project is on the shores of the Charvak reservoir in the Bostanlyk district of the Tashkent region, approximately 80 km from Tashkent. The announced masterplan covers 527 hectares.

What homes are available?

The August 2026 announcement introduces White Villas, apartments in White Residences and private villas ranging from 290 to 1,200 m². Contact the official sales team for current availability, floor plans, pricing and completion schedules.

Is the resort already completed?

The project is being developed in phases over the announced 2025-2035 period. The latest August 2026 update reports the start of concrete works. The imagery on this website presents architectural concepts and does not represent completed facilities.

Will the destination be open all year?

Yes, it is conceived as an all-season destination. The official concept combines summer beach and outdoor activities with sports and wellness offerings during winter.

Will local residents have beach access?

The developer’s published plans include both free and paid beach zones, with a comparable standard of amenities, alongside open public spaces, boulevards and walking routes.

How will Charvak’s water be protected?

The published requirements prohibit wastewater discharge into the reservoir and call for connection to the Chirchiq wastewater treatment system. The project also describes environmental oversight and water-quality monitoring.

What transport improvements are planned?

The official FAQ describes upgrades to access roads, additional parking and a planned bridge connecting parts of the area. These are development plans and should be confirmed with the project team as delivery progresses.
